Simplify a Piecewise expression

Source: R/piecewise-simplify.R
piecewise_simplify.Rd

piecewise_simplify(expr) simplifies the expressions and conditions of a Piecewise, rewrites univariate conditions as disjoint intervals, uses equality conditions to simplify their expressions, and merges segments that agree, as SymPy's piecewise_simplify(). simplify_univariate() writes a boolean in one variable as a union of intervals. distribute_or_over_and() puts a boolean into disjunctive form.

Usage

distribute_or_over_and(expr)

piecewise_simplify(expr, deep = TRUE, kw = .simp_kw(), ...)

simplify_univariate(expr)

Arguments

expr

A Piecewise or boolean expression.

deep

Unused; kept for SymPy's signature.

kw

Options of simplify() (internal).

...

Ignored.

Value

An expression.

Examples

x <- Symbol("x")
piecewise_simplify(Piecewise(list(x^2, x < 0), list(x^2, x > 0), list(0, TRUE)))
#> Piecewise((x^2, (x > 0) | (x < 0)), (0, True))
simplify_univariate((x > 0) & (x < 2) | (x > 1))
#> (x >= 1) | ((1 <= x) & (x <= 2)) | ((x <= 2) & (0 < x))
